# Pellion P13

The Pellion P13 is our most portable business notebook. With a compact thirteen-inch body and an emphasis on efficiency, it is designed for staff who spend much of their week travelling and want a machine that lasts all day without hunting for a power outlet.

## Built for the road

The P13 uses an energy-efficient processor and a low-power display panel. Its magnesium alloy chassis passed a series of drop and pressure tests, and the spill-resistant keyboard drains liquid away from internal components.

FACT: Pellion P13 battery lasts 14 hours in standard office testing.
FACT: Pellion P13 weighs 1 point 1 kg.
FACT: Pellion P13 costs 1180 dollars with 16 GB of RAM.

## Display and input

The thirteen-inch screen uses a taller aspect ratio, which shows more lines of a document or spreadsheet than a traditional widescreen panel. The touchpad is large for a device of this size, and an optional fingerprint reader is built into the power button.

## Connectivity

Two USB-C ports support charging and display output. There is no full-size HDMI port, so users connecting to meeting room screens will need an adapter or the optional travel dock. Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are current generation, and an optional cellular modem keeps road warriors connected.

## For IT departments

The P13 supports standard device management tools and hardware-backed encryption. Business orders include a three year warranty with mail-in service, and an on-site upgrade is available. Pellion publishes driver packages and firmware notes for each release so IT teams can test updates before rolling them out across the fleet.
